messages.author: 350dad0a615d36db
messages.subject: "Distance" R package paper now out
parts:
Good morning listfolk,

Our paper describing the Distance R package is now out in the Journal of
Statistical Software (you may have seen a preprint of this on bioRxiv
some time ago).

You can read the final version here:

https://www.jstatsoft.org/article/view/v089i01

To cite the Distance R package in publications, reports etc please now use:

Miller DL, Rexstad E, Thomas L, Marshall L, Laake JL (2019). "Distance
Sampling in R." Journal of Statistical Software, 89(1), 1-28. doi:
10.18637/jss.v089.i01.

(You can obtain this plus the appropriate bibtex entry using
citation("Distance") in R.)



cheers,
--dave
